declared.title: The effect of productive failure in a digital inquiry environment on developing deep understanding and achievement of organic chemistry among secondary school students
declared.foundIn: OpenAlex search « productive failure Arab students » (2026-11-23)

population: 66 final-year secondary students (32 vs 34, one school each), Wadi Al-Dawasir, Riyadh region, Saudi Arabia; organic chemistry on Microsoft Teams, 2020-2021

findings.text: Saudi students taught through productive failure scored higher in deep understanding and achievement than the control group

support.sentence: The results revealed that there were statistically significant differences at α = 0.05 between the means of the scores of the experimental and control groups in the deep understanding level and the achievement test of organic chemistry in favour of the experimental group.

limits: quasi-experiment (the author's « semi-experimental » design): one school per group, schools drawn, not students; condition, school and teacher are confounded
pretest results not reported; the control group's teaching not described; productive failure mixed with a digital inquiry environment
eta squared about 0.8 (full text), roughly d = 3.7: ten times the mean of the meta-analysis, implausible for a school intervention
text and tables disagree on which sub-scores are significant; one author, no preregistration, no cluster analysis
the only Arab sample found for this idea, but too weak to carry « it works in the Arab world »: at most « a small Saudi study points the same way »
